identity.eligibility_criteria: Lifelong renewability, no upper exit age, Indian residents.
identity.renewal_terms: Lifelong renewability with 7.5% - 10% multi-year tenure discounts.
identity.portability_conditions: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines with waiting period continuity.

coverage.inpatient_hospitalization: Covered up to 100% of Sum Insured for all hospital charges.
coverage.daycare_procedures: All daycare procedures covered without sub-limits.
coverage.domiciliary_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured for medical necessity.
coverage.home_healthcare: Covered for chemotherapy and specified home treatments.
coverage.ayush_treatment: 100% of Sum Insured covered in recognized AYUSH institutes.
coverage.ambulance_cover: Covered up to ₹10,000 per hospitalization (Road) and optional Air Ambulance.
coverage.organ_donor_expenses: Covered up to Sum Insured for harvesting charges.
coverage.modern_treatments: Covered up to Sum Insured for robotic surgeries and modern treatments.
coverage.maternity_cover: Not covered under base Care Supreme variant.
coverage.opd_dental_vision: Available as Care OPD add-on for consultations and investigations.
coverage.restoration_benefit: Unlimited automatic restoration of 100% Sum Insured for same/unrelated illness.
coverage.cumulative_bonus: Cumulative Bonus 50% per claim-free year up to 100% of Sum Insured.
coverage.wellness_benefits: Discount on renewal premium based on fitness activities (BeFit app tracking).
coverage.critical_illness_rider: Optional Critical Illness and Personal Accident rider.

restrictions.room_rent_capping: No Room Rent Capping (Any room type: Single Private, Twin Sharing, or Suite). No proportionate deductions.
restrictions.icu_sub_limit: No sub-limit on ICU charges (Covered up to Sum Insured).
restrictions.pre_authorization_rules: Cashless pre-auth at least 48h prior for planned, 24h for emergency.
restrictions.medical_necessity_clause: Must be certified as medically required by a registered medical practitioner.
restrictions.non_payable_items: Covered if Claim Shield add-on is opted (pays for gloves, masks, syringes, and consumables).

premium.pricing_factors: Age of eldest member, chosen Sum Insured, and optional add-on covers.
premium.installment_options: Annual, Half-yearly, Quarterly, and Monthly auto-debit.
premium.medical_underwriting: Tele-medical or physical checkup required for age 50+ or disclosed conditions.
premium.cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund within 15 days free-look period; pro-rata short period table thereafter.

claims.cashless_claim_procedure: Present Care health card at network hospital TPA desk -> Pre-auth processed in under 2 hours.
claims.reimbursement_claim_procedure: Submit hospital bill, original discharge summary, and pharmacy receipts within 30 days.
claims.grievance_redressal_details: Care Customer Support: 1800-102-4455 / customerfirst@careinsurance.com / Insurance Ombudsman.
claims.tpa_support: In-house Claim Management Team (No external TPA required).
